cohort: 1253 pregnant women who attended Combined Military Hospital (CMH), Savar, Dhaka for delivery between January 2014 and December 2015.
finding: Among the 1253 participants, 70.3% underwent caesarean section (CS) and 29.7% had normal vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Previous caesarean birth was the most common indication for caesarean section (42.4%).
